question: What is UPAI Labs?
answer: UPAI Labs Foundation (Uttar Pradesh AI Labs) is a Section 8 not-for-profit company, incorporated in March 2025 and based in Lucknow. It builds the AI ecosystem in Tier-2 cities through community events, open-source projects, research and mentorship.

question: How are UPAI Labs, Lucknow AI Labs and AI Community Lucknow related?
answer: Lucknow AI Labs is the first chapter of UPAI Labs and has run events in Lucknow since November 2023. AI Community Lucknow (earlier TFUG Lucknow) is a separate, independent community that runs many events together with us. Our events page shows who organised each event.

question: Who can take part?
answer: Students, developers, researchers, founders and professionals who want to learn about AI or build with it. Beginners are welcome.

question: How do I join an event?
answer: Events are announced and registered on Commudle (commudle.com/communities/upai-labs) and in our WhatsApp and Discord groups. Upcoming events are also listed on our events page.

question: How can my company or college partner with UPAI Labs?
answer: We work with companies, colleges and communities to host events, sponsor hackathons and run workshops. Use the contact form and choose "Sponsorship or partnership", and we will get back to you.

question: How can I volunteer, mentor or give a talk?
answer: Volunteer roles and the mentorship programme are described on the Lucknow AI Labs website. To propose a talk or workshop, use the contact form and choose "Volunteer or mentor".

question: Can I contribute to your projects?
answer: Yes. All our projects are open source on GitHub at github.com/LucknowAI. Pick a project, read its README, and open an issue or a pull request.

question: Are you opening chapters in other cities?
answer: Lucknow is our first chapter. We open a new chapter once the one before it can run on its own. If you would like to start one in your city, tell us through the contact form.
